description: The line plot illustrates the harmful with refusal ratio for different configurations of a safety reminder system across various model sizes. The x-axis represents the model size, with values 128, 256, 512, and 1024, indicating the size of the models in terms of the number of parameters. The y-axis measures the harmful with refusal ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 0.5, which quantifies the effectiveness of the safety reminder in preventing harmful actions. There are four lines representing different configurations: LiaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep, Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep, LiaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench, and Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench. The LiaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep line starts at approximately 0.2 at model size 128 and increases to about 0.4 at model size 1024. The Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep line begins at around 0.1 at model size 128 and rises to approximately 0.3 at model size 1024. The LiaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench line starts at about 0.1 at model size 128 and increases to roughly 0.3 at model size 1024. The Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench line begins at around 0.1 at model size 128 and goes up to about 0.2 at model size 1024. The lines show a general trend of increasing harmful with refusal ratio as the model size increases, with the LiaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep configuration showing the highest ratio at the largest model size.
